detail.longDescription: Your AI assistant is great at helping you write a formula, clean up a messy column, or summarize a tab. Then you close the chat, and the spreadsheet is still waiting on you to paste in last night's leads, log the new orders, and ping the team about the row someone just changed. Here's a way to hand that work off. Install Zapier in your AI assistant, describe what should land in your Google Sheet and when, and your agent builds the automation.
